short.q: A sector has radius 10 cm and angle 72°. Calculate its perimeter. Give your answer to 3 significant figures.
A cylinder has radius 4 cm and height 9 cm. Find its volume and its total surface area, in terms of π.
short.model: Volume = π × 4² × 9 = 144π cm³. Total surface area = 2π × 4 × 9 + 2π × 4² = 72π + 32π = 104π cm².
